statements.statement: The patient has recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits consistent with prior transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a history of cerebral infarction
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) was ordered
The study was ordered to evaluate for potential paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias contributing to these embolic events
The denial reason code is CO-97
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure
